text:
ren: Heads-up  saw a sponsored post from 'FluxStack' claiming 'no infra, instant scale, fastest p50' — want microplays for SDRs + a single webinar slide. Need by EOD tomorrow. :eyes:

mona: can you paste the ad copy or screenshot?

ren: pasted link in thread. Key bits: 'no infra work', 'auto-scale instantly', and a chart comparing p50 vs 'standard setups'.

lucy: framing suggestion: emphasize production tradeoffs. 'No infra work' sounds nice but ignores per-workload kernel selection, KV cache benefits, and routing/fallback policies. Keep it non-technical in SDR lines.

olga: SDR microplays (one short sentence each):
- For Eng leads: 'We tune runtime to your model and traffic so production latency is more predictable.'
- For Business leads: 'Consistent latency and clear unit-cost controls across hosted, dedicated, and private.'

samir: love the clarity. Webinar micro-slide (very short): three bullets + a 1-line footnote explaining why 'no infra work' can be misleading.

lucy: proposed bullets (short):
1) Serving-first runtime: kernel selection, batching, KV cache
2) Cost levers: batching, caching, quantization guidance
3) Operational controls: routing, reserved capacity, observability

olga: footnote suggestion: '"No infra work" claims often skip per-workload tuning that affects latency and unit cost.' Keep it plain and avoid numeric claims.

mona: legal note: avoid terms like 'tail latency' or specific percentages unless ops signs off. Use 'more predictable' or 'improved' instead.

ren: short SDR rebut for live chat (one line):
`FluxStack: "no infra work"`
`Redwood: "We tune runtime to your workload so production apps see more predictable latency and controllable unit costs."`

samir: minor tweak: swap 'controllable' for 'transparent'  sounds better for pitch.

olga: final SDR lines (drop these in Notion):
- Eng: 'We tune runtime to your workload for more predictable production latency.'
- Biz: 'Predictable latency and transparent unit-cost controls across deployment choices.'

mona: action items:
- @olga: drop final two SDR one-liners in Notion (tech + biz) by 3pm PT tomorrow
- @lucy: create the 1-slide webinar frame with the 3 bullets + footnote by EOD tomorrow
- @mona: run quick legal check on final phrasing and flag any banned words
ops-bot: Reminder set: Notion + slide drafts due 15:00 PT tomorrow (channel: #marketing).

ren: thanks all  keep it short, human, and verifiable. :thumbsup:
